==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Uncle Bin:''' If only Port Gunchao could always stay peaceful like this...
:{{DIcon}} How long have you been a Patroller?
:'''Uncle Bin:''' It's been many years since this port completed when I joined the Patrollers.
:'''Uncle Bin:''' After that, I stayed here every day, handling immigration issues while guarding the port.
:{{DIcon}} Don't you feel lonely?
::'''Uncle Bin:''' No. I've got Port Gunchao with me. It's always there, quiet and peaceful.
:{{DIcon}} Don't you feel bored?
::'''Uncle Bin:''' No. Seeing the calm and peaceful Port Gunchao, it just puts my mind at ease.
:'''Uncle Bin:''' Even if my legs grow old and weak, I'll still hold it dear in my heart.
{{Dialogue End}}
